comparison:
JSON validity controls from pinned SQLite's randomjson test-data generator.

Only the C oracle process loads the upstream extension. Production never calls
the generator, C, Python, or an external parser. Four input representations per
seed (JSON text, JSON5 text, JSONB of each) pass through both public file modes.
All masks/default and every ordered output row are compared, with immutable
main/WAL bytes and independent C typed-row/integrity observations.

runs.sql: SELECT id,json_valid(v),json_valid(v,1),json_valid(v,2),json_valid(v,3),json_valid(v,4),json_valid(v,5),json_valid(v,6),json_valid(v,7),json_valid(v,8),json_valid(v,9),json_valid(v,10),json_valid(v,11),json_valid(v,12),json_valid(v,13),json_valid(v,14),json_valid(v,15) FROM t ORDER BY id;
